主要内容: On January 14, 2019, Ron Morrison resigned as Executive Vice President and General Counsel of Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. (the "Company"). In connection with his departure, Mr. Morrison and the Company entered into a Separation and Release Agreement. The Company agreed to pay Mr. Morrison a severance payment of $300,000, permit the exercise of vested and outstanding options aggregating 132,700 with exercise prices ranging from $2.73 to $20.50 until the earlier of December 31, 2019 or the expiration date, and provide health benefits until December 31, 2019. Mr. Morrison and family members were also removed as beneficiaries to a life insurance policy for which the Company provides collateral.
